walkthroughs.body_html:
Q = m c delta T.

0.5 kg water by 20 C: Q = 0.5 x 4200 x 20 = 42000 J.

Convert volume carefully: 1 cm^3 = 1 x 10^-6 m^3.

Use rho = m / V.

What did Rutherford's alpha-scattering experiment show about the atom?
options: It showed that alpha particles can pass through any material because they are massless.
Most of the atom is empty space, with a tiny dense positive nucleus.
It showed that atoms are solid spheres of positive charge with electrons embedded inside.
Heat is measured in degrees Celsius and temperature in Joules.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between heat and temperature?
options: Heat is the energy transferred due to temperature difference; temperature measures average kinetic energy of particles.
Heat is measured in degrees Celsius and temperature in Joules.
Fusion is harder because you need to break atoms apart first.
Heat and temperature are the same thing — both measure how hot something is.

mcqs.q: Why is nuclear fusion much harder to achieve on Earth than fission?
options: It showed that alpha particles can pass through any material because they are massless.
Fusion is harder because you need to break atoms apart first.
Fusion is harder because the materials are rarer than uranium.
Fusion requires extremely high temperatures and pressures to overcome the electrostatic repulsion between positive nuclei.
